7.3.3 Access to FlexRay
The Bus Mirroring module accesses the FlexRay bus through the FlexRay Interface
module (FrIf). After the Bus Mirroring module starts the mirroring of a FlexRay bus,
the FlexRay Interface module reports received and transmitted FlexRay frames to the
Bus Mirroring module. The FlexRay bus state is polled cyclically from the Mirror_-
MainFunction. A FlexRay source bus corresponds to a FlexRay cluster, which can
be connected to several controllers.
